snapshot.text: Mixed system with high out-of-pocket spending. Universal health coverage (CSU) has been rolled out in phases since 2023 with a mixed record, and a new National Health Development Plan runs 2026–2030.

priorities.title: Universal health coverage
priorities.text: Phased roll-out of CSU, including more than 6 million home visits by community health workers.

priorities.title: Health plan 2026–2030
priorities.text: A National Health Development Plan for 2026–2030 with its monitoring framework.
